what: Several color tabs stack in a 4.875-column strip on the left, and the chosen photo panel fills the side (column = board width/90). Picking a tab ahead pushes the passed tabs 51 cells to the right to form a right-side strip, the passed board clears from the left edge in 1.1s, and the chosen board moves one strip to the left (1s expo.out). Picking backward makes the board cover in from the right and the tabs return to place (only the last board .1s later)

options.tab: Actual tab width (cells, overlaps beneath the next tab), default 9
options.push: Distance past tabs are pushed (steps), default 51
options.clip-dur: Time in seconds for the panel to clear when moving forward, default 1.1
options.late: Seconds the last panel lags when picking backward, default .1
options.[data-fx-part=tab]·[data-fx-part=panel]: Tabs and panels (children) paired in order — first pair is rightmost (topmost). Tab background is painted by the user
options.Event: Send fx:pick(detail.index) to the element to jump to that cell, and fx:tab-strip-picker(detail.index) fires on every pick
